UNIT_ACCESS.title: Unit access
UNIT_ACCESS.help: Manage unit scope for existing account members. Assignment, teams and action permissions remain separate. Revoking preserves membership history.
UNIT_ACCESS.choose_unit: Select a unit to search members and their access.
UNIT_ACCESS.parent_inactive: Unit or operator company inactive: operational access is blocked.
UNIT_ACCESS.roles_help: Action permissions are configured in Settings → Custom roles and assigned in Settings → Agents by an account administrator authorized to use those native settings. This page only manages unit scope. A membership does not grant action permissions.

COMMON.structure: Service Desk - candidate for acceptance testing
COMMON.select_record: Select an authorized record to view its details.
COMMON.no_records: No records match the applied filters.

STATES.not_found: Ticket not found or not accessible
STATES.idle_help: No data has been queried yet.
STATES.loading_help: Waiting for the backend. Previous values are not reused.
STATES.pending_help: This resource has a functional dependency documented for this candidate. No demonstration records are used.
STATES.denied_help: An active unit membership and action permission are required. Administrators do not receive automatic access.
STATES.unauthenticated_help: Confirm your JRC session before retrying.
STATES.error_help: The query failed. No changes were made.
STATES.invalid_contract_help: The response does not match the expected contract or scope. Data was discarded.
STATES.invalid_request_help: Review filters and scope. The query will not silently broaden its scope.
STATES.not_found_help: No authorized record could be confirmed for this address.
STATES.empty_help: The API returned an empty list for this authorized query.
STATES.disabled_help: The Account feature must be enabled to access the module.

SCOPE.title: Operational scope
SCOPE.hint: The operating company is derived from the unit. A team does not grant another unit.
SCOPE.native_pending: PENDING - native validation in Docker/local environment
SCOPE.contract_pending: Operational context unavailable. Retry or review access and setup.

FILTERS.mine_hint: Personal filtering runs on the backend, not a local count.
FILTERS.local_hint: Filters, search, totals and pages are processed by the authorized API query.

OVERVIEW.kpi_help: No real aggregation available. No total or percentage is inferred from the ticket page.
OVERVIEW.chart_help: Waiting for a real series and verifiable source. No demo chart is displayed.
OVERVIEW.tasks_help: The task API is not available yet.
OVERVIEW.copilot_help: NICO suggestions and actions require authorized integration. No insight was generated.

TICKET.subtitle: Find and organize tickets within the authorized scope.
TICKET.sla_pending: Deadlines depend on the backend calculator and versioned conditions. There is no local countdown.
TICKET.related_help: Links are authorized references. Messages and records are not duplicated.
TICKET.note_help: Internal notes are stored through the authorized API; they are not public replies.
TICKET.history_help: The API must return only authorized events for this ticket.
TICKET.not_loaded: Load an authorized ticket before editing its data.
TICKET.no_actions: No action is authorized or configured for this record in the current context.

FORM.subtitle: Choose an authorized unit and requester, classify the ticket and review before saving through the API.
FORM.draft_notice: Only Save submits data. A fresh API read confirms each write.
FORM.client_help: Contacts and customer companies remain native records. Queries must use the authorized scope.
FORM.classify_help: Priorities, categories and statuses come from real unit configuration. No options are preseeded in the frontend.
FORM.relationships_help: Contracts, services, assets and CRM will be selected through authorized APIs. Free text does not create a link.
FORM.projects_help: Projects is a separate module. No project or project link is included in this candidate.
FORM.review_help: Review the fields. Save will submit and read back the persisted ticket.
FORM.source_help: The API will validate the source. This does not select or send messages through a channel.
FORM.attachments_help: Up to five files of 20 MB each. Access requires security verification.
FORM.required_help: Unit, requester, title and priority must be validated by the backend before creation.
FORM.edit_help: Editing requires a loaded record and explicit permission. Saving requires API acknowledgement and readback.
FORM.status_help: Requires an explicitly configured initial status in this unit.
FORM.no_permission: Creation permission has not been confirmed by the backend.
FORM.catalogue_restricted: Explicitly select the company and contract authorized for this service.

CATALOG.subtitle: Operational configuration by Account and unit without changing customer records.
CATALOG.form_notice: Actions depend on the resource and the authorized capabilities. Unimplemented operations remain explicitly pending.
CATALOG.unit_hint: A unit belongs to an operating company in the same Account. No default unit is created.
CATALOG.assignee_hint: Assignees need AccountUser and active unit membership. A team does not replace that membership.
CATALOG.operator_hint: Operating companies are not customer companies, teams or NICO settings.
CATALOG.queue_hint: Manual assignment uses authorized queues. Automatic routing, skills, capacity and calendars remain pending.
CATALOG.settings_help: Manage permitted catalogues and versioned policies. Structure and membership grants are not automatic.
CATALOG.contract_hint: This is the existing authorized CRM contract lookup. A selected Service Desk unit provides access context; contracts remain account/customer records and are not assigned to that unit.

PLANNED.subtitle: Reference layout. Data and actions are not operational yet.
PLANNED.data_notice: This domain still has no operational API in this delivery. No data was fabricated.
PLANNED.contract_help: The contractual source is external. Applied, versioned conditions will be displayed here, not an ERP.
PLANNED.knowledge_help: Internal knowledge access and publication require separate permission. The existing Help Center remains intact.
PLANNED.portal_help: The client portal requires a dedicated Contact-linked identity. No public route or client session is included.
PLANNED.empty_metric: Waiting for queries and mathematical validation in the appropriate checkpoint.

OPS.same_unit: Only assignees, teams and queues in this unit. The queue team is derived when omitted.
OPS.work_status_help: Work status changes require an explicit published rule. Pause, resolve, close and reopen use the authorized lifecycle panel.
OPS.lifecycle_pending: A valid lifecycle policy and its required configuration are necessary for this operation.
OPS.note_internal: Internal note persisted on this ticket. No customer message is sent.
OPS.conversation_help: Use the real internal ID, not just the displayed number. The API checks Account and native permissions. No messages are copied or sent.
OPS.kpi_rule: Total = open + waiting + resolved + closed + cancelled. Active = open + waiting. All queries respect filters and current access.

STATUS.saving: Submitting and confirming by a fresh API read...
STATUS.confirmed: Data confirmed by a fresh API read.
STATUS.conflict: Version or request-key conflict. Reload before trying again.
STATUS.invalid_input: Input rejected. Review the fields and permitted scope.
STATUS.invalid_contract: Incompatible response. Success was not confirmed.
STATUS.error: The result could not be confirmed. The request may have reached the server; retry with the same key or inspect the list.
STATUS.readback_pending: The API accepted the write, but readback was not confirmed. Reload; do not assume the write failed.
STATUS.intent_changed: The previous attempt is unconfirmed. Inspect the list before submitting different data.
STATUS.interrupted: Interrupted in this view. The write may have been received; inspect the list.

OPS.lookup_disabled: Selection is unavailable in this context or during a write.

LIFECYCLE.title: Lifecycle
LIFECYCLE.classification: This rule requires classification. Set a category in ticket editing before submitting.
LIFECYCLE.no_actions: No transition is allowed for this state and context. The reopening window may be unavailable or expired.
LIFECYCLE.no_applicable_policy: No active applicable policy. Dependent operations are denied.
LIFECYCLE.calendar_snapshot_required: PENDING: a compatible calendar snapshot and explicit targets are required; no deadline was simulated.
LIFECYCLE.clock_notice: Deadlines use the versioned calendar. During a pause the last commitment is shown and will be recalculated on resume. An internal note does not prove a first customer response.
LIFECYCLE.editor_notice: Advanced configuration validated by the backend. Follow the documented contract: no rule is filled automatically. Publication creates a new version and does not migrate bound tickets.
LIFECYCLE.publish: Publish new version and read back

feedback.saving: Saving and confirming with an independent read...
feedback.confirmed: Operation confirmed by reading the backend again.
feedback.readback_pending: The operation could not be fully confirmed. Reload its record/history before another attempt; a timeout does not prove the write failed.
feedback.dependency: Blocked by an SLA/calendar dependency. No partial effect was confirmed.
feedback.conflict: Record or policy changed. Refresh and inspect the result before retrying.
feedback.invalid_input: Invalid input or unmet requirements. Review the rule and evidence.
feedback.error: Unable to confirm the operation. Check history before retrying.

LIFECYCLE.expired_require_new_ticket: After expiration: use normal creation for a separate ticket; no ticket is created automatically.
LIFECYCLE.recover: Confirm again using the SAME request key

NATIVE.company_from_contact: Company linked to the contact; available in ticket details
NATIVE.not_linked: No company linked to this contact
NATIVE.not_available: Native company registry unavailable in this installation
NATIVE.role_help: Service Desk permissions require the feature and an active unit membership. Select module access and other prerequisites explicitly. A custom role does not inherit administrator defaults. Team membership does not grant a unit.

ADMIN.notice: Unit-scoped records. Saves require server authorization, audit receipt and an independent read. No physical deletion.
ADMIN.active_label: Active: uncheck to deactivate; save to persist.
ADMIN.deactivation_warning: Deactivation preserves history. It can block future selections or lifecycle rules using this record. Code cannot be changed.
ADMIN.structure_pending: Structural changes use the Service Desk structure area and require explicit delegation. This operational lookup stays read-only.

feedback.saving: Saving and verifying audit and record...
feedback.confirmed: Change confirmed by independent server reads.
feedback.readback_pending: The result is uncertain. Recover the same request before starting another attempt.
feedback.conflict: Configuration changed. Reload before editing again.
feedback.invalid_request: Invalid fields or requirements not met.
feedback.not_found: Record not available in this scope.
feedback.invalid_contract: Response does not match the required contract.

STRUCTURE.title: Service Desk structure
STRUCTURE.separation: Structural administration is scoped to this Account. It does not grant ticket access. Only an authorized JRC employee can initialize an empty Account.
STRUCTURE.name: Name / member
STRUCTURE.no_self_grant: No physical deletion or self-grant. Enabling a client membership grants scope, not capabilities. Review Account and recipient before saving.

states.denied: No structural authority for this Account.
states.error: The request failed. No successful empty list or saved state is assumed.
states.empty: The authorized query returned no records.
states.confirmed: The audit receipt and record were read again and match the operation.
states.confirmation_pending: The write responded but could not be confirmed. Recover the same request before starting another.
states.conflict: The record or key conflicts with the current state. Read again before retrying.
states.invalid: Review the fields, required reference and selected IDs.

COCKPIT.notifications_off: External notifications are off by default. Select a linked customer conversation explicitly; the current approved policy controls delivery.
COCKPIT.scan_unavailable: A verified malware scan is required before download.
COCKPIT.conflict: The record changed. Reload before trying again.
COCKPIT.error: The operation could not be confirmed.

delivery_state.blocked: Blocked by current policy or channel dependency

KNOWLEDGE.source: Published articles from the existing Help Center. Drafts and internal interactions are not published here.

V2.board_help: Open the ticket to review the authorized evidence, complete tasks or decide an approval.
V2.observed_help: The report uses authorized persisted tickets and clock evidence. Missing measurements stay unavailable. CSAT uses the shared survey report.
V2.approval_required: This service requires an approved decision before resolution or closure.

V2_SETTINGS.availability_help: New memberships stay unavailable. New automatic distribution and claim actions require an explicit positive capacity. Empty capacity keeps these actions unavailable; existing manual assignments remain valid.
V2_SETTINGS.capacity: Maximum active tickets for automatic distribution and claim
V2_SETTINGS.distribution_help: Manual is the default. Automatic modes require an available eligible operator with capacity and the queue skills. Changing these settings does not change customer SLA history.
V2_SETTINGS.ola_budget: OLA budget in seconds (empty disables OLA)
V2_SETTINGS.approval_required: Require an approved decision before resolution or closure
V2_SETTINGS.portal_help: OFF by default. Select the actual widget and an authorized active operator in this unit. The customer remains the author; the operator authority is rechecked on every creation and retry. Select an active default priority before enabling.
V2_SETTINGS.options_unavailable: Native choices are unavailable with the current permissions. Reload after reviewing the unit and inbox access.
V2_SETTINGS.executor: Real operator authorized to create and link tickets
V2_SETTINGS.portal_enabled: Publish this service in the verified customer portal
V2_SETTINGS.claim_blocked: Claim is unavailable with current availability, capacity or eligibility. Review the operator settings.
V2_SETTINGS.claim_empty: No eligible unassigned ticket is available in this unit.
V2_SETTINGS.claim_pending: The claim result could not yet be verified. Retry with the same request.
V2_SETTINGS.claim_denied: Current authorization no longer permits this claim.
V2_SETTINGS.restrictions_help: No restrictions when the list is empty. Choose authorized records explicitly.

R2.portal_only: Publish to the customer portal without notification
R2.preview_invalid: The preview expired or changed. Review again.
R2.published_blocked: Published. Notification blocked by the displayed dependency.
R2.uncertain: Result could not be verified. Refresh before retrying.
R2.confirm_policy: I approve this version and its executing operator
R2.default_off: Event notifications remain OFF until an explicit version is approved. The publishing operator is the execution identity.

reasons.recipient_preference: Customer channel preference blocks this notification

R3.select_unit: Select an authorized unit to create or edit records.
R3.task_progression: Create the next task on completion
R3.published_progression_help: Requires a current published lifecycle policy and explicit administrative permission. Disabled by default.
R3.preferences_help: Choose the channels this customer permits. Clearing both prevents Service Desk notifications.

SNAPSHOT.title: Record a native SLA snapshot
SNAPSHOT.notice: Provide the exact source versions, timezone, capture instant and JSON conditions. This appends an immutable historical snapshot; it does not calculate deadlines, select a calendar or activate a lifecycle policy.

feedback.confirmed: Snapshot confirmed by a separate authorized read.
feedback.recorded_restricted: The server confirmed the record receipt. Its conditions are not available with your current permissions.
feedback.denied: The snapshot is no longer accessible with your current permissions.
feedback.invalid_input: Check the explicit source, timezone, capture instant and JSON objects.
feedback.conflict: The source changed. Review the current native record before trying again.
feedback.readback_pending: The result has not been verified. Verify the same pending snapshot before creating another.

SURVEYS.native_scope: Select an authorized unit to inspect its native Service Desk surveys. The shared survey engine and current source permissions remain authoritative.

CLOCK_AUTOMATION.title: Automatic clock monitoring
CLOCK_AUTOMATION.notice: Disabled until explicitly approved. Each evaluation uses the selected operator, current unit permissions and the exact published clock policy. Changing the operator turns automatic monitoring off.
CLOCK_AUTOMATION.automations_help: Configure native lifecycle rules, queue OLA monitoring and customer notifications. New policies stay disabled until explicitly configured and approved.

COMPLETION.title: Operational rules and completion
COMPLETION.help: Published numeric precedence: lower values win. Equal matching precedence blocks the operation. Explicit assignments win over channel rules; catalogue defaults apply last. Disabled rules do not activate historical tickets.
COMPLETION.optional_predicates: Optional predicates (all supplied predicates must match)
COMPLETION.snapshot_help: Use the existing snapshot contract. Provide approved provenance, conditions, calendar and budgets; no source or budget is inferred or verified against an external provider.
COMPLETION.target_value: Explicit target ID or native role
COMPLETION.recurrence_help: Rolling 24-hour days; suggestions are restricted to authorized tickets. Missing classification is not proof of the same defect. A human confirms grouping.
COMPLETION.confirmed: I reviewed the configuration, authority and precedence
COMPLETION.invalid: Invalid, incomplete or conflicting configuration. Review the fields and refresh.
COMPLETION.unavailable: Unavailable or access changed. No result is presumed.
COMPLETION.deadline_help: Applies only to new approvals created while this exact version is enabled. Replacing or disabling the rule cancels its future automatic effects on previous approvals. Each approval escalates once; other cases remain manual.
COMPLETION.matrix_help: Optional published impact/urgency matrix. Selecting both codes resolves priority in the backend; leaving both blank preserves manual priority.
COMPLETION.routing_help: Use published channel routing and ignore the assignment defaults shown below. The channel must come from an authorized linked conversation; otherwise only an explicitly published fallback can match.
COMPLETION.report_help: Select a unit. Optional filters use canonical IDs and timestamps with an explicit timezone. CSV export is limited to 10,000 authorized tickets.
COMPLETION.metric_definition: FCR and quality are not calculated without an approved definition. Reopen percentage uses the visible ticket cohort, not first-contact resolution.
COMPLETION.truncated: The result was truncated. Narrow the scope before drawing conclusions.
COMPLETION.disabled: No enabled configuration. Ask an authorized administrator to publish an explicit policy.

actions.note: Publish progress to selected linked tickets

COMPLETION.batch_help: Review exact structured matches, select tickets, then preview a finite operation on an existing incident. Suggestions never merge or notify automatically.
COMPLETION.selection_changed: Selection changed. Review the preview again.
COMPLETION.readback: Applied and confirmed by independent readback.
COMPLETION.pending_readback: Request may have been applied. Reuse the same key or inspect the incident; do not assume failure or create a new batch.
COMPLETION.units_note: IDs refer to the authorized native records. No new customers, services or queues are created by this form.
COMPLETION.report_definition: Cohort: tickets opened in [from, to). Reopen events are counted within the same period. First-contact resolution and quality remain unavailable until their definitions are approved.
COMPLETION.channel_overlap: A ticket linked to several authorized channels may appear in more than one channel count.
COMPLETION.reopen_summary: Reopens: {events} events / {tickets} tickets, in a cohort of {cohort_ticket_count}.
COMPLETION.sla_summary: Latest native SLA cycle: completed clocks
COMPLETION.rules_off: Recurrence policy is not enabled for this unit.
COMPLETION.no_external: No external message is sent by these batch operations.
